description: This file defines the InterestRefundServiceDelegate class, which delegates interest refund handling to specific InterestRefundService implementations based on a Loan object. It is part of the loan account service package in the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestRefundServiceDelegate
classes.description: A service component that selects an appropriate InterestRefundService implementation for a given Loan.

methods.name: lookupInterestRefundService
methods.description: Finds and returns an InterestRefundService that can handle the provided Loan, or null if none is suitable.
